144: <script>
145:   // Smooth scroll for anchor links
146:   document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((element) => {
147:     const anchor = element as HTMLAnchorElement;
148:     anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e: Event) {
149:       e.preventDefault();
150:       const href = this.getAttribute('href');
151:       if (href) {
152:         const targetElement = document.querySelector(href);
153:         if (targetElement) {
154:           targetElement.scrollIntoView({
155:             behavior: 'smooth',
156:             block: 'start'
157:           });
158:           
159:           // Update URL without jumping
160:           history.pushState(null, '', href);
161: 
162:           // Update active state manually
163:           document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {
164:             link.classList.remove('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
165:           });
166:           this.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
167:         }
168:       }
169:     });
170:   });
171: 
172:   // Highlight current section in sidebar
173:   const observerOptions = {
174:     root: null,
175:     rootMargin: '-20% 0px -70% 0px', // Adjust the margins to make detection more accurate
176:     threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1] // Multiple thresholds for better accuracy
177:   };
178: 
179:   const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
180:     entries.forEach(entry => {
181:       if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.6) { // Only trigger when section is more than 60% visible
182:         const id = entry.target.id;
183:         const sidebarLink = document.querySelector(`a[href="#${id}"]`);
184:         
185:         // Remove active class from all links
186:         document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {
187:           link.classList.remove('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
188:         });
189:         
190:         // Add active class to current link
191:         if (sidebarLink) {
192:           sidebarLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
193:         }
194:       }
195:     });
196:   }, observerOptions);
197: 
198:   // Wait for DOM to be fully loaded
199:   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
200:     // Observe all sections
201:     const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
202:     sections.forEach(section => {
203:       observer.observe(section);
204:     });
205: 
206:     // Set initial active state based on URL hash or first section
207:     const hash = window.location.hash;
208:     if (hash) {
209:       const activeLink = document.querySelector(`a[href="${hash}"]`);
210:       if (activeLink) {
211:         activeLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
212:       }
213:     } else {
214:       const firstLink = document.querySelector('a[href^="#"]');
215:       if (firstLink) {
216:         firstLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
217:       }
218:     }
219:   });
220: </script>
`````

  2: import Layout from "../layouts/LayoutCourse.astro";
  3: import { Chat as ChatComponent } from "@/components/Chat";
  4: import { normalizeConfig } from "@/schema/chat";
  5: 
  6: import type { ChatConfig } from "@/schema/chat"; // Import the type
  7: 
  8: interface Props {
  9:   frontmatter?: any; // Make frontmatter optional as config might come via chatConfig prop
 10:   chatConfig?: ChatConfig; // Add chatConfig prop
 11:   // For MDX files
 12:   Content?: any;
 13:   // Raw content
 14:   content?: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: // Destructure props, getting chatConfig directly if passed
 18: const { chatConfig: passedChatConfig, Content, content } = Astro.props;
 19: 
 20: // Get the raw content
 21: let rawContent = '';
 22: 
 23: try {
 24:   // First try: Direct content if provided
 25:   if (content && typeof content === 'string') {
 26:     rawContent = content;
 27:     console.log('[Direct content found]', {
 28:       length: content.length,
 29:       preview: content.substring(0, 100)
 30:     });
 31:   }
 32:   
 33:   // Second try: MDX/Markdown Content component
 34:   if (!rawContent && Content?.rawContent) {
 35:     rawContent = await Content.rawContent();
 36:     console.log('[Markdown content found]', {
 37:       length: rawContent.length,
 38:       preview: rawContent.substring(0, 100)
 39:     });
 40:   }
 41:   
 42:   // Last try: Render default slot
 43:   if (!rawContent) {
 44:     rawContent = await Astro.slots.render('default');
 45:     if (rawContent) {
 46:       console.log('[Slot content found]', {
 47:         length: rawContent.length,
 48:         preview: rawContent.substring(0, 100)
 49:       });
 50:     }
 51:   }
 52: } catch (error) {
 53:   console.error('[Content extraction failed]:', error);
 54: }
 55: 
 56: // Use the passed chatConfig prop directly, merging with potential rawContent
 57: const chatConfig = normalizeConfig({
 58:   ...(passedChatConfig || {}), // Use the passed config object
 59:   // If includeContent is true (based on the passed config), add the raw slot content
 60:   ...(passedChatConfig?.includeContent && rawContent ? { content: rawContent } : {})
 61: });
 62: 
 63: // Debug final state
 64: console.log('Content processing:', {
 65:   type: typeof rawContent,
 66:   rawLength: rawContent?.length || 0,
 67:   rawPreview: rawContent ? rawContent.substring(0, 100) : 'N/A',
 68:   includeContent: Boolean(passedChatConfig?.includeContent),
 69:   isJSON: typeof rawContent === 'string' && rawContent.startsWith('{'),
 70:   contentSettings: {
 71:     hasContent: Boolean(rawContent),
 72:     includeContent: Boolean(passedChatConfig?.includeContent)
 73:   }
 74: });

`````

  2: import Layout from "../../layouts/Docs.astro";
  3: import { getCollection } from "astro:content";
  4: import type { CollectionEntry } from "astro:content";
  5: import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
  6: import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
  7: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
  8: import {
  9:   RocketIcon,
 10:   LayersIcon,
 11:   InfoCircledIcon,
 12:   LightningBoltIcon,
 13:   MagnifyingGlassIcon
 14: } from "@radix-ui/react-icons";
 15: import {
 16:   Grid2x2,
 17:   Grid3x3, Search,
 18:   BookText,
 19:   FileText,
 20:   List,
 21:   Table,
 22:   Grid,
 23:   Tag,
 24:   Folder,
 25:   FolderOpen
 26: } from "lucide-react";
 27: import { ChatConfigSchema } from '../../schema/chat';
 28: 
 29: // Type definitions
 30: type DocEntry = CollectionEntry<'docs'>;
 31: type DocFolder = Record<string, DocEntry[]>;
 32: 
 33: // Get view preference from URL or default to list view
 34: const viewMode = (Astro.url.searchParams.get("view") || "list") as
 35:     | "list"
 36:     | "compact"
 37:     | "grid1"
 38:     | "grid2"
 39:     | "grid3"
 40:     | "grid4";
 41: 
 42: // Get all docs entries
 43: const entries = (await getCollection("docs")) as DocEntry[];
 44: 
 45: // Get search query from URL
 46: const searchQuery = Astro.url.searchParams.get("search")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 47: 
 48: // Get tag filter from URL
 49: const tagFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("tag")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 50: 
 51: // Get folder filter from URL
 52: const folderFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("folder")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 53: 
 54: // Filter entries by search query, tag, or folder
 55: const filteredEntries = searchQuery || tagFilter || folderFilter
 56:   ? entries.filter((entry: DocEntry) => {
 57:       const title = entry.data.title?.toLowerCase() || '';
 58:       const description = entry.data.description?.toLowerCase() || '';
 59:       const section = entry.data.section?.toLowerCase() || '';
 60:       const tags = entry.data.tags?.map((t: string) => t.toLowerCase()) || [];
 61:       const folderPath = entry.slug.split('/')[0].toLowerCase();
 62:       
 63:       // If folder filter is present, it takes precedence
 64:       if (folderFilter) {
 65:         return folderPath === folderFilter;
 66:       }
 67:       
 68:       // If tag filter is present, it takes precedence over search
 69:       if (tagFilter) {
 70:         return tags.includes(tagFilter);
 71:       }
 72:       
 73:       // Otherwise use search query
 74:       return title.includes(searchQuery) || 
 75:              description.includes(searchQuery) || 
 76:              section.includes(searchQuery) ||
 77:              tags.some((tag: string) => tag.includes(searchQuery));
 78:     })
 79:   : entries;
 80: 
 81: // Group by folders (first level of path)
 82: const folders = filteredEntries.reduce((acc: DocFolder, entry: DocEntry) => {
 83:   // Extract the folder name from the slug (first part before slash, or 'root' if no slash)
 84:   const folderPath = entry.slug.includes('/') 
 85:     ? entry.slug.split('/')[0] 
 86:     : 'root';
 87:   
 88:   if (!acc[folderPath]) {
 89:     acc[folderPath] = [];
 90:   }
 91:   acc[folderPath].push(entry);
 92:   return acc;
 93: }, {});
 94: 
 95: // Sort folders alphabetically with 'root' at the top
 96: const orderedFolders = Object.entries(folders)
 97:   .sort(([a, _a]: [string, DocEntry[]], [b, _b]: [string, DocEntry[]]) => {
 98:     if (a === 'root') return -1;
 99:     if (b === 'root') return 1;
100:     return a.localeCompare(b);
101:   })
102:   .reduce((acc, [key, value]) => ({ ...acc, [key]: value }), {}) as Record<string, DocEntry[]>;
103: 
104: // Configure AI assistant for docs
105: const chatConfig = ChatConfigSchema.parse({
106:   systemPrompt: [{
107:     type: "text" as const,
108:     text: `You are a documentation expert for ONE framework, helping users navigate and understand the documentation. Focus on:
109: - Explaining documentation sections and their relationships
110: - Providing quick access to relevant documentation
111: - Clarifying technical concepts
112: - Suggesting next steps in the learning path`
113:   }],
114:   welcome: {
115:     message: "👋 Need help finding documentation? Ask me anything!",
116:     avatar: "/icon.svg",
117:     suggestions: [
118:       {
119:         label: "🚀 Quick Start",
120:         prompt: "How do I get started with ONE?"
121:       },
122:       {
123:         label: "📚 Learning Path",
124:         prompt: "What's the recommended learning path?"
125:       },
126:       {
127:         label: "💡 Features",
128:         prompt: "What are ONE's main features?"
129:       }
130:     ]
131:   }
132: });
133: 
134: // Get appropriate icon based on folder name
135: function getFolderIcon(folder: string) {
136:   switch (folder.toLowerCase()) {
137:     case 'getting-started':
138:       return RocketIcon;
139:     case 'core-concepts':
140:       return LayersIcon;
141:     case 'advanced':
142:     case 'ai-sdk':
143:       return LightningBoltIcon;
144:     case 'tutorials':
145:       return BookText;
146:     case 'troubleshooting':
147:       return InfoCircledIcon;
148:     default:
149:       return FolderOpen;
150:   }
151: }
152: 
153: // Format folder name for display
154: function formatFolderName(folder: string): string {
155:   if (folder === 'root') return 'Get Started ';
156:   
157:   // Replace hyphens with spaces and capitalize each word
158:   return folder
159:     .replace(/-/g, ' ')
160:     .split(' ')
161:     .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
162:     .join(' ');
163: }
164: 
165: // Function to create tag URL
166: function createTagUrl(tag: string): string {
167:   return `/docs?tag=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`;
168: }
169: 
170: // Function to create folder URL
171: function createFolderUrl(folder: string): string {
172:   return `/docs?folder=${encodeURIComponent(folder)}`;
173: }

551: <script>
552:   // Handle search form submission
553:   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
554:     const docSearchForm = document.querySelector('form');
555:     const docSearchInput = docSearchForm?.querySelector('input[type="search"]') as HTMLInputElement;
556:     const viewModeLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="?view="]');
557:     
558:     if (docSearchForm && docSearchInput) {
559:       // Add event listener for the form submission
560:       docSearchForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
561:         if (docSearchInput.value.trim() === '') {
562:           // If search is empty and we're already on the docs page with no query,
563:           // prevent the default action to avoid unnecessary page refresh
564:           const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
565:           if (currentUrl.pathname === '/docs' && !currentUrl.searchParams.has('search')) {
566:             e.preventDefault();
567:           }
568:         }
569:       });
570:       
571:       // Set focus on search input with a slight delay
572:       setTimeout(() => {
573:         if (docSearchInput.value) {
574:           // If there's a search value, place cursor at the end
575:           docSearchInput.setSelectionRange(docSearchInput.value.length, docSearchInput.value.length);
576:         }
577:       }, 100);
578:     }
579:     
580:     // Update view mode links to preserve search query and tag filter
581:     if (viewModeLinks.length > 0) {
582:       const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
583:       const currentSearch = searchParams.get('search');
584:       const currentTag = searchParams.get('tag');
585:       const currentFolder = searchParams.get('folder');
586:       
587:       viewModeLinks.forEach(link => {
588:         const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
589:         let newHref = href;
590:         
591:         if (currentSearch && !newHref.includes('search=')) {
592:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `search=${encodeURIComponent(currentSearch)}`;
593:         }
594:         
595:         if (currentTag && !newHref.includes('tag=')) {
596:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `tag=${encodeURIComponent(currentTag)}`;
597:         }
598:         
599:         if (currentFolder && !newHref.includes('folder=')) {
600:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `folder=${encodeURIComponent(currentFolder)}`;
601:         }
602:         
603:         if (newHref !== href) {
604:           link.setAttribute('href', newHref);
605:         }
606:       });
607:     }
608:   });
609: </script>

 42: // Get all lessons entries

 44:

 47: 
 48: // Get tag filter from URL
 49: const tagFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("tag")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 50: 
 51: // Get folder filter from URL
 52: const folderFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("folder")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 53: 
 54: // Filter entries by search query, tag, or folder
 55: const filteredEntries = searchQuery || tagFilter || folderFilter
 56:   ? entries.filter((entry: DocEntry) => {
 57:       const title = entry.data.title?.toLowerCase() || '';
 58:       const description = entry.data.description?.toLowerCase() || '';
 59:       const section = entry.data.section?.toLowerCase() || '';
 60:       const tags = entry.data.tags?.map((t: string) => t.toLowerCase()) || [];
 61:       const folderPath = entry.slug.split('/')[0].toLowerCase();
 62:       
 63:       // If folder filter is present, it takes precedence
 64:       if (folderFilter) {
 65:         return folderPath === folderFilter;
 66:       }
 67:       
 68:       // If tag filter is present, it takes precedence over search
 69:       if (tagFilter) {
 70:         return tags.includes(tagFilter);
 71:       }
 72:       
 73:       // Otherwise use search query
 74:       return title.includes(searchQuery) || 
 75:              description.includes(searchQuery) || 
 76:              section.includes(searchQuery) ||
 77:              tags.some((tag: string) => tag.includes(searchQuery));
 78:     })
 79:   : entries;
 80: 
 81: // Group by folders (first level of path)
 82: const folders = filteredEntries.reduce((acc: DocFolder, entry: DocEntry) => {
 83:   // Extract the folder name from the slug (first part before slash, or 'root' if no slash)
 84:   const folderPath = entry.slug.includes('/') 
 85:     ? entry.slug.split('/')[0] 
 86:     : 'root';
 87:   
 88:   if (!acc[folderPath]) {
 89:     acc[folderPath] = [];
 90:   }
 91:   acc[folderPath].push(entry);
 92:   return acc;
 93: }, {});

595:     background-attachment: fixed;

610: <script>
611:   // Handle search form submission
612:   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
613:     const lessonsearchForm = document.querySelector('form');
614:     const lessonsearchInput = lessonsearchForm?.querySelector('input[type="search"]') as HTMLInputElement;
615:     const viewModeLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="?view="]');
616:     
617:     if (lessonsearchForm && lessonsearchInput) {
618:       // Add event listener for the form submission
619:       lessonsearchForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
620:         if (lessonsearchInput.value.trim() === '') {
621:           // If search is empty and we're already on the lessons page with no query,
622:           // prevent the default action to avoid unnecessary page refresh
623:           const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
624:           if (currentUrl.pathname === '/lessons' && !currentUrl.searchParams.has('search')) {
625:             e.preventDefault();
626:           }
627:         }
628:       });
629:       
630:       // Set focus on search input with a slight delay
631:       setTimeout(() => {
632:         if (lessonsearchInput.value) {
633:           // If there's a search value, place cursor at the end
634:           lessonsearchInput.setSelectionRange(lessonsearchInput.value.length, lessonsearchInput.value.length);
635:         }
636:       }, 100);
637:     }
638:     
639:     // Update view mode links to preserve search query and tag filter
640:     if (viewModeLinks.length > 0) {
641:       const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
642:       const currentSearch = searchParams.get('search');
643:       const currentTag = searchParams.get('tag');
644:       const currentFolder = searchParams.get('folder');
645:       
646:       viewModeLinks.forEach(link => {
647:         const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
648:         let newHref = href;
649:         
650:         if (currentSearch && !newHref.includes('search=')) {
651:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `search=${encodeURIComponent(currentSearch)}`;
652:         }
653:         
654:         if (currentTag && !newHref.includes('tag=')) {
655:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `tag=${encodeURIComponent(currentTag)}`;
656:         }
657:         
658:         if (currentFolder && !newHref.includes('folder=')) {
659:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `folder=${encodeURIComponent(currentFolder)}`;
660:         }
661:         
662:         if (newHref !== href) {
663:           link.setAttribute('href', newHref);
664:         }
665:       });
666:     }
667:   });
668: </script>
`````

 1: Hi. I'm Anthony O'Connell. I help companies attract, convert and grow customers using the web and AI. I founded and built ONE. I will be your teacher.

10: I bought the first server that allowed secure transmission of credit cards over the internet. Before Netscape you couldn't do secure transactions on the web.

14: In 2009 I was asked to join the Education and Business Advisory Boards of the Lifeboat Foundation, a nonprofit nongovernmental organization. I was really honoured to join other board members including inventor/futurist Ray Kurzweil, Director of Engineering at Google; Alex Wolszczan, discoverer of the first planets ever found outside our solar system; Ian Foster, "father of grid computing," Frank Wilczek, winner of the 2004 Nobel Prize in Physics; and Sir Clive W.J. Granger, winner of the 2003 Nobel Prize in Economics. I believe in freedom of speech, privacy, and open technology.

17:

19:

I set up & managed marketing & research companies for Ogilvy (Ireland) and iMarketing (Australia). I developed strategies for companies in a diverse range of industries from smart drugs e.g. Prymd Labs (US) to consumer products e.g. Unilever (US), to media e.g. The Government of Thailand.

I lead the research and development of ONE's strategy, design, website, engineering, AI, marketing and education. My passion is for teaching - both kids and executives. My goal is to help you grow your skills and business with AI.

  1: ---
  2: import { getCollection } from 'astro:content';
  3: import DocsPage from '../../layouts/LayoutCourse.astro';
  4: import type { CollectionEntry } from 'astro:content';
  5: import { ChatConfigSchema } from '../../schema/chat';
  6: import LessonContent from '@/components/lessons/LessonContent.astro';
  7: 
  8: export const prerender = true;
  9: 
 10: export async function getStaticPaths() {
 11:   const lessons = await getCollection('lessons');
 12:   return lessons.map((entry: CollectionEntry<'lessons'>) => ({
 13:     params: { slug: entry.slug },
 14:     props: { entry },
 15:   }));
 16: }
 17: 
 18: type Props = {
 19:   entry: CollectionEntry<'lessons'>;
 20: };
 21: 
 22: const { entry } = Astro.props;
 23: const { Content } = await entry.render();
 24: 
 25: // Get chat configuration from frontmatter or use defaults
 26: const chatConfig = ChatConfigSchema.parse({
 27:   // Layout and Meta
 28:   layout: entry.data.layout || "lesson",
 29:   title: entry.data.title || "Lesson",
 30:   description: entry.data.description || "Learn more about this topic",
 31:   
 32:   // AI Config
 33:   aiProvider: entry.data.aiProvider || "openrouter",
 34:   aiModel: entry.data.aiModel || "google/gemini-2.0-flash-001",
 35:   apiEndpoint: entry.data.apiEndpoint || "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
 36:   temperature: entry.data.temperature || 0.7,
 37:   maxTokens: entry.data.maxTokens || 4000,
 38: 
 39:   // Prompt Config
 40:   systemPrompt: entry.data.aiConfig?.systemPrompt || [
 41:     {
 42:       type: "text",
 43:       text: `I am your AI Learning Assistant for "${entry.data.title || 'this lesson'}". I'm here to help you understand and apply the concepts covered in this lesson.
 44: 
 45: My role is to:
 46: 1. Answer questions about the lesson content
 47: 2. Provide additional examples and explanations
 48: 3. Help you apply concepts to real-world scenarios
 49: 4. Guide you through practical exercises
 50: 5. Clarify any confusing points
 51: 
 52: I have deep knowledge of this lesson's content and can help you master the material. What would you like to learn more about?`
 53:     }
 54:   ],
 55:   addSystemPrompt: true,
 56:   addBusinessPrompt: true,
 57: 
 58:   // Welcome Config
 59:   welcomeMessage: entry.data.aiConfig?.welcomeMessage || `👋 Welcome to "${entry.data.title || 'this lesson'}"! How can I help you understand this topic better?`,
 60:   avatar: entry.data.aiConfig?.avatar || "/icon.svg",
 61:   suggestions: entry.data.aiConfig?.suggestions || [
 62:     { 
 63:       label: "📚 Key Concepts", 
 64:       prompt: "What are the main concepts covered in this lesson?" 
 65:     },
 66:     { 
 67:       label: "💡 Examples", 
 68:       prompt: "Can you provide some practical examples from this lesson?" 
 69:     },
 70:     { 
 71:       label: "❓ Questions", 
 72:       prompt: "I have a question about something in this lesson..." 
 73:     },
 74:     { 
 75:       label: "🔍 Deep Dive", 
 76:       prompt: "Let's explore this topic in more detail" 
 77:     }
 78:   ],
 79: 
 80:   // Optional Config
 81:   runtime: "edge",
 82:   includeContent: true
 83: });
 84: ---
 85: 
 86: <DocsPage 
 87:   title={entry.data.title}
 88:   description={entry.data.description}
 89:   chatConfig={chatConfig}
 90:   rightPanelMode={entry.data.rightPanelMode || "quarter"}
 91: >
 92:   <div class="px-4 sm:px-6">
 93:     {entry.data.lessonContent ? (
 94:       <LessonContent content={entry.data.lessonContent} />
 95:     ) : (
 96:       <div class="prose dark:prose-invert max-w-none">
 97:         <Content />
 98:       </div>
 99:     )}
100:   </div>
101: </DocsPage>
`````

 575: <Layout
 576:   title="ONE - Build Your AI Brand"
 577:   chatConfig={{
 578:     // Layout and Meta
 579:     layout: "home",
 580:     title: "ONE - Build Your AI Brand",
 581:     description: "AI-powered solutions with ONE",
 582:     
 583:     // AI Config
 584:     aiProvider: "openrouter",
 585:     aiModel: "google/gemini-2.0-flash-001",
 586:     apiEndpoint: "https://api.openai.com/v1",
 587:     temperature: 0.7,
 588:     maxTokens: 999999,
 589: 
 590:     // Prompt Config
 591:     systemPrompt: [{
 592:       type: "text",
 593:       text: "I am your AI guide to building with ONE. I'll help you understand and implement our powerful toolkit."
 594:     }],
 595:     addSystemPrompt: true,
 596:     addBusinessPrompt: true,
 597: 
 598:     // Welcome Config
 599:     welcomeMessage: "👋 Welcome! I'm here to help you build amazing AI-powered solutions with ONE. What would you like to learn about?",
 600:     avatar: "/icon.svg",
 601:     suggestions: [
 602:       { label: "🚀 Quick Start Guide", prompt: "Show me how to get started with ONE quickly" },
 603:       { label: "💡 Key Features", prompt: "What are the main features of ONE?" },
 604:       { label: "🤖 AI Capabilities", prompt: "What AI features does ONE provide?" }
 605:     ],
 606: 
 607:     // Optional Config
 608:     runtime: "edge",
 609:     includeContent: true
 610:   }}
 611:   rightPanelMode="quarter"
 612: >
 613: <main class="min-h-screen bg-background">
 614:   {/* Hero Section */}
 615:   <section class="container mx-auto px-6 py-16 border-b border-border bg-background/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
 616:     <div class="w-full max-w-[1400px] mx-auto flex flex-col items-center gap-8 text-center">

 618:         {courseDetails.badge}
 619:       </Badge>
 620:

 622:         {courseDetails.title}
 623:       </h1>
 624:

 626:         {courseDetails.subtitle}
 627:       </p>
 628:       
 629:       <p class="text-lg md:text-xl text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed tracking-wide max-w-2xl">
 630:         {courseDetails.valueProposition}
 631:       </p>
 632:

1880: // Smooth scroll function with proper TypeScript types
1881: document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((anchor: Element) => {
1882:   anchor.addEventListener('click', function(this: HTMLAnchorElement, e: Event) {
1883:     e.preventDefault();
1884:     const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href') || '');
1885:     if (target) {
1886:       const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
1887:       const startPosition = window.pageYOffset;
1888:       const distance = targetPosition - startPosition;
1889:       const duration = 1500; // 1.5 seconds
1890:       let start: number | null = null;
1891: 
1892:       function animation(currentTime: number): void {
1893:         if (start === null) start = currentTime;
1894:         const timeElapsed = currentTime - start;
1895:         const progress = Math.min(timeElapsed / duration, 1);
1896:         
1897:         // Easing function for smoother animation
1898:         const ease = (t: number): number => 
1899:           t < .5 ? 4 * t * t * t : (t - 1) * (2 * t - 2) * (2 * t - 2) + 1;
1900:         
1901:         window.scrollTo(0, startPosition + distance * ease(progress));
1902:         
1903:         if (timeElapsed < duration) {
1904:           requestAnimationFrame(animation);
1905:         }
1906:       }
1907:       
1908:       requestAnimationFrame(animation);
1909:     }
1910:   });
1911: });
1912: </script>

  1: import { z } from 'zod';

  6: const ProviderSchema = z.enum(['openai', 'anthropic', 'mistral', 'openrouter'])

 31: });

 35:

 38:   description: z.string().optional(),
 39:   keywords: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 40:   categories: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 41: 
 42: 
 43:   aiProvider: ProviderSchema.optional().default('openrouter'),
 44:   aiModel: z.string().optional().default('google/gemini-2.0-flash-001'),
 45:   apiEndpoint: z.string().url().optional().default('https://api.openai.com/v1'),
 46:   temperature: z.number().min(0).max(2).optional().default(0.7),
 47:   maxTokens: z.number().min(1).max(999999).optional().default(999999),
 48: 
 49:

 52:   addBusinessPrompt: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
 53:

 94: 
 95:   if (config.addBusinessPrompt) {
 96:     const businessPrompt = loadPromptContent('src/content/prompts/business.md');
 97:     if (businessPrompt) prompts.push(businessPrompt);
 98:   }
 99: 
100: 
101:   if (config.systemPrompt) {
102:     prompts.push(typeof config.systemPrompt === 'string'
103:       ? config.systemPrompt
104:       : config.systemPrompt.map((p: ContentPart) => p.text).join('\n\n')
105:     );
106:   }
107: 
108: 
109:   return prompts.map(text => ({
110:     type: 'text' as const,
111:     text: text.trim()
112:   }));
113: }
114: 
115: 
116: export const ChatSchema = BaseChatSchema.transform((config): Chat => ({
117:   ...config,
118:   provider: config.aiProvider || 'mistral',
119:   model: config.aiModel || 'mistral-large-latest',
120:   welcome: {
121:     message: config.welcomeMessage || 'How can I help you today?',
122:     avatar: config.avatar || '/icon.svg',
123:     suggestions: (config.suggestions || []).map(suggestion =>
124:       typeof suggestion === 'string'
125:         ? { label: suggestion, prompt: suggestion }
126:         : suggestion
127:     )
128:   },
129:   systemPrompt: combinePrompts(config)
130: }));
131: 
132: 
133: export interface Chat extends BaseChat {
134:   provider: string;
135:   model: string;
136:   welcome: {
137:     message: string;
138:     avatar: string;
139:     suggestions: Array<{ label: string; prompt: string; }>;
140:   };
141:   systemPrompt: ContentPart[];
142: }
143: 
144: 
145: export type ChatConfig = Chat;
146: 
147: 
148: export const ChatConfigSchema = ChatSchema;
149: 
150: 
151: export function normalizeConfig(config: Record<string, any>): Chat {
152:   return ChatSchema.parse(config || {});
153: }
154: 
155: export function createChat(overrides?: Partial<Chat>): Chat {
156:   return ChatSchema.parse(overrides || {});
157: }
158: 
159: export const createDefaultConfig = createChat;

 25: export function CountdownTimer({

 31: }: CountdownTimerProps) {
 32:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<TimeLeft>({ days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
 33:   const [isExpired, setIsExpired] = useState(false);
 34: 
 35:   useEffect(() => {
 36:     const calculateTimeLeft = () => {
 37:       try {
 38:         const now = new Date().getTime();
 39:         const target = new Date(targetDate).getTime();
 40:         const difference = target - now;
 41: 
 42: 
 43:         if (difference <= 0) {
 44:           setIsExpired(true);
 45:           setTimeLeft({ days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
 46:           if (onComplete) onComplete();
 47:           return;
 48:         }
 49: 
 50: 
 51:         const days = Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
 52:         const hours = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
 53:         const minutes = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
 54:         const seconds = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
 55: 
 56:         setTimeLeft({ days, hours, minutes, seconds });
 57:       } catch (error) {
 58:         console.error('Error calculating time left:', error);
 59:       }
 60:     };
 61: 
 62: 
 63:     calculateTimeLeft();

If, by the end of our scheduled sessions, you don't feel we have achieved this foundational implementation together, I will personally work with you to find a solution or offer a full refund.
213:               </p>

215:           </div>
216:         </Card>

  2: import Layout from "./Layout.astro";
  3: import { ChatConfigSchema, type Chat } from "../schema/chat";

  5: 
  6: interface Props {
  7:   title: string;
  8:   description?: string;
  9:   children: any;
 10:   header?: boolean;
 11:   footer?: boolean;
 12:   chatConfig?: Chat;
 13:   rightPanelMode?: "hidden" | "full" | "half" | "quarter" | "floating" | "icon";
 14:   content?: string;
 15:   // For MDX files
 16:   Content?: any;
 17: }
 18: 
 19: const { title, description, header = true, footer = true, Content } = Astro.props;
 20: 
 21: // Get the raw content with fallbacks
 22: let rawContent = '';
 23: 
 24: try {
 25:   // First try: Direct content if provided
 26:   if (Astro.props.content && typeof Astro.props.content === 'string') {
 27:     rawContent = Astro.props.content;
 28:   }
 29:   
 30:   // Second try: MDX/Markdown Content component
 31:   if (!rawContent && Content) {
 32:     try {
 33:       if (Content.rawContent) {
 34:         rawContent = await Content.rawContent();
 35:       } else if (Content.render) {
 36:         const rendered = await Content.render();
 37:         rawContent = rendered.props.markdown;
 38:       }
 39:     } catch (error) {
 40:       console.error('[Content extraction warning]:', error);
 41:     }
 42:   }
 43:   
 44:   // Last try: Render default slot
 45:   if (!rawContent) {
 46:     try {
 47:       rawContent = await Astro.slots.render('default');
 48:     } catch (error) {
 49:       console.error('[Slot rendering warning]:', error);
 50:       rawContent = '';
 51:     }
 52:   }
 53: } catch (error) {
 54:   console.error('[Content extraction failed]:', error);
 55: }

 61:   systemPrompt: `You are ONE's documentation specialist, helping users understand our comprehensive toolkit for building AI-powered brands. Your role is to guide users through the documentation and help them understand:
 62: 
 63: • Toolkit Components
 64:   - Rich prompt library and templates

150:   function wrapCodeBlocks() {
151:     document.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(pre => {
152:       // Only wrap if not already wrapped
153:       if (!pre.parentElement?.classList.contains('code-block-wrapper')) {
154:         const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
155:         wrapper.className = 'code-block-wrapper relative';
156:         pre.parentNode?.insertBefore(wrapper, pre);
157:         wrapper.appendChild(pre);
158:         
159:         // Add copy button container
160:         const copyContainer = document.createElement('div');
161:         copyContainer.className = 'copy-button-container absolute top-2 right-2';
162:         copyContainer.innerHTML = `
163:           <button class="relative inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-700/50"
164:                   onclick="
165:                     const btn = this;
166:                     const pre = btn.closest('.code-block-wrapper').querySelector('pre');
167:                     navigator.clipboard.writeText(pre.textContent).then(() => {
168:                       // Show tooltip
169:                       const tooltip = document.createElement('span');
170:                       tooltip.className = 'copy-tooltip';
171:                       tooltip.textContent = 'Copied!';
172:                       btn.appendChild(tooltip);
173: 
174:                       // Animate icon
175:                       btn.querySelector('svg').style.color = '#22c55e';
176:                       btn.querySelector('svg').style.animation = 'copy-feedback 0.2s ease';
177:                       
178:                       // Reset after animation
179:                       setTimeout(() => {
180:                         btn.querySelector('svg').style.color = '';
181:                         btn.querySelector('svg').style.animation = '';
182:                         tooltip.remove();
183:                       }, 1000);
184:                     });
185:                   ">
186:             <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"
187:                  stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
188:                  class="text-slate-400">
189:               <rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"/>
190:               <path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"/>
191:             </svg>
192:           </button>
193:         `;
194:         wrapper.appendChild(copyContainer);
195:       }
196:     });
197:   }
198: 
199:   // Run on page load and after navigation
200:   wrapCodeBlocks();
201:   document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', wrapCodeBlocks);
202: </script>

500: ---
501: <Layout
502:   title="ONE - The AI Playbook for Ecommerce"
503:   chatConfig={chat}
504:   rightPanelMode="quarter"
505: >
506:   <main class="min-h-screen bg-background">
507:     {/* Hero Section */}
508:     <CourseHeroSection courseDetails={courseDetails} heroStats={heroStats} />
509: 
510:     <Circles />
511: 
512:     {/* System Overview */}
513:     <div id="framework">
514:       <FrameworkOverview client:load />
515:     </div>
516: 
517:     {/* ELEVATE Framework */}
518:     <div id="elevate" class="py-20">
519:       <Elevate client:visible />
520:     </div>
521: 
522:     {/* How It Works */}
523:     <div id="how-it-works">
524:       <HowFrameworkWorks client:visible />
525:     </div>
526: 
527:     {/* Business Transformation */}
528:     <div id="transformation">
529:       <Transformation client:visible />
530:     </div>
531: 
532:     <Teacher />
533: 
534:     {/* Course Modules */}
535:     <div id="modules" class="relative py-20 bg-gradient-to-b from-background to-background/80">
536:       <div class="container mx-auto px-4">
537:         <div class="text-center mb-16">
538:           <Badge variant="outline" className="mb-4">
539:             Complete Framework
540:           </Badge>
541:           <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-4">Master The ELEVATE Framework</h2>
542:           <p class="text-xl text-muted-foreground max-w-2xl mx-auto">
543:             A systematic approach to transform your ecommerce growth through AI-powered automation
544:           </p>
545:         </div>
546: 
547:         <div class="grid gap-16">
548:           {courseModulesData?.map((module, index: number) => module && (
549:             <div class="relative">
550:               {/* Module Header */}
551:               <div class="flex items-center gap-6 mb-8">
552:                 <div class="flex-shrink-0 w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
553:                   <span class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{index.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</span>
554:                 </div>
555:                 <div>
556:                   <h3 class="text-3xl font-bold mb-2">{module.title}</h3>
557:                   <p class="text-xl text-muted-foreground">{module.description}</p>
558:                 </div>
559:               </div>
560: 
561:               {/* Module Content */}
562:               <Card className="p-8">
563:                 {/* Two Column Content */}
564:                 <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-8">
565:                   {/* Left Column */}
566:                   <div>
567:                     <h4 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Overview</h4>
568:                     <p class="text-muted-foreground mb-6">{module.details?.overview}</p>
569:                     
570:                     <h4 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Key Features</h4>
571:                     <ul class="space-y-3">
572:                       {module.features.map((feature) => (
573:                         <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
574:                           <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-primary mt-1" />
575:                           <span>{feature}</span>
576:                         </li>
577:                       ))}
578:                     </ul>
579:                   </div>
580: 
581:                   {/* Right Column */}
582:                   <div>
583:                     <h4 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-4">What You'll Learn</h4>
584:                     <ul class="space-y-4">
585:                       {module.details?.benefits.map((benefit) => (
586:                         <li class="flex items-start gap-3">
587:                           <div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
588:                             <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
589:                           </div>
590:                           <span class="text-muted-foreground">{benefit}</span>
591:                         </li>
592:                       ))}
593:                     </ul>
594:                   </div>
595:                 </div>
596: 
597:                 {/* Implementation Section - Full Width */}
598:                 <div class="border-t pt-8">
599:                   <div class="bg-muted/50 rounded-lg p-6">
600:                     <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
601:                       <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
602:                         <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
603:                       </div>
604:                       <h4 class="text-xl font-semibold">Implementation Steps</h4>
605:                     </div>
606:                     <div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
607:                       {module.details?.implementation.map((step, stepIndex) => (
608:                         <div class="relative">
609:                           <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
610:                             <div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-primary/5 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 border border-primary/10">
611:                               <span class="text-sm font-medium text-primary">{stepIndex + 1}</span>
612:                             </div>
613:                             <p class="text-muted-foreground">{step}</p>
614:                           </div>
615:                         </div>
616:                       ))}
617:                     </div>
618:                   </div>
619:                 </div>
620:               </Card>
621: 
622:               {/* Module Connector Line */}
623:               {index < courseModulesData.length - 1 && (
624:                 <div class="absolute left-8 top-[90px] bottom-0 w-px bg-border" />
625:               )}
626:             </div>
627:           ))}
628:         </div>
629:       </div>
630:     </div>
631: 
632:     {/* Pricing Section */}
633:     <div id="pricing">
634:       <PricingSection client:visible pricingData={pricingData} />
635:     </div>
636: 
637:     {/* Countdown Timer */}
638:     <CountdownTimer 
639:       client:visible 
640:       targetDate={courseDetails.launchDate}
641:       currentPrice={pricingData.currentPrice}
642:       originalPrice={pricingData.originalPrice}
643:     />
644: 
645:     {/* FAQs Section */}
646:     <div id="faq" class="min-h-screen">
647:       <FAQSection client:visible faqs={faqs} />
648:     </div>
649: 
650:     {/* Final CTA */}
651:     <FinalCTA 
652:       client:visible 
653:       currentPrice={pricingData.currentPrice} 
654:       remainingSpots={pricingData.scarcity.spots.remaining} 
655:       guaranteeText={pricingData.guarantee.description}
656:     />
657:   </main>
658: </Layout>
659: 
660: <style>
661:   html {
662:     scroll-behavior: smooth;
663:     --scroll-duration: 1.5s;
664:   }
665:   
666:   .no-underline {
667:     text-decoration: none;
668:     color: inherit;
669:   }
670: 
671:   /* Modern Shadcn-style button enhancements */
672:   .button-shadow {
673:     position: relative;
674:     transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
675:     box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
676:   }
677: 
678:   .button-shadow:hover {
679:     transform: translateY(-1px);
680:     box-shadow: 
681:       0 10px 25px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1),
682:       0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
683:   }
684: 
685:   .button-shadow:active {
686:     transform: translateY(0);
687:     box-shadow: 
688:       0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1),
689:       0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
690:   }
691: 
692:   .button-glow {
693:     position: relative;
694:     overflow: hidden;
695:   }
696: 
697:   .button-glow::before {
698:     content: '';
699:     position: absolute;
700:     inset: -2px;
701:     background: linear-gradient(
702:       to right,
703:       hsl(var(--primary) / 0.1),
704:       hsl(var(--primary) / 0.2),
705:       hsl(var(--primary) / 0.1)
706:     );
707:     z-index: -1;
708:     border-radius: inherit;
709:     transition: all 0.3s ease;
710:     opacity: 0;
711:   }
712: 
713:   .button-glow:hover::before {
714:     opacity: 1;
715:   }
716: 
717:   .button-primary {
718:     background: linear-gradient(
719:       to bottom right,
720:       hsl(var(--primary)),
721:       hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9)
722:     );
723:     border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary) / 0.2);
724:   }
725: 
726:   .button-outline {
727:     background: transparent;
728:     border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary) / 0.2);
729:   }
730: 
731:   .button-outline:hover {
732:     background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.1);
733:   }
734: 
735:   /* Badge styles */
736:   .badge-glow {
737:     background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.1);
738:     border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary) / 0.2);
739:     color: hsl(var(--primary));
740:     padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
741:     border-radius: 9999px;
742:     font-size: 0.75rem;
743:     font-weight: 500;
744:     letter-spacing: 0.025em;
745:   }
746: 
747:   /* Add smooth reveal animation for modules */
748:   @keyframes fadeInUp {
749:     from {
750:       opacity: 0;
751:       transform: translateY(20px);
752:     }
753:     to {
754:       opacity: 1;
755:       transform: translateY(0);
756:     }
757:   }
758: 
759:   #modules .relative {
760:     animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out forwards;
761:     opacity: 0;
762:   }
763: 
764:   #modules .relative:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
765:   #modules .relative:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
766:   #modules .relative:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
767:   #modules .relative:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
768:   #modules .relative:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
769:   #modules .relative:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }
770:   #modules .relative:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 0.7s; }
771:   #modules .relative:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 0.8s; }
772:   #modules .relative:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 0.9s; }
773: </style>
774: 
775: <script>
776:   // Smooth scroll function
777:   document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((anchor: Element) => {
778:     anchor.addEventListener('click', function(this: HTMLAnchorElement, e: Event) {
779:       e.preventDefault();
780:       const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href') || '');
781:       if (target) {
782:         target.scrollIntoView({
783:           behavior: 'smooth',
784:           block: 'start'
785:         });
786:       }
787:     });
788:   });
789: </script>
`````
